# Dennis Gerrits

> Personal travel companion and storyteller in Amsterdam. Dennis walks alongside visitors and shows the city the way a friend would, instead of running fixed tour packages.

Dennis Gerrits is based in Amsterdam and offers private, personal days out: neighborhood walks, canal and water routes, food culture, art, architecture and quiet corners. He also works with travel advisors and concierges as their local partner in Amsterdam, hosts a podcast about the city, and writes short stories from his notebook.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Who Dennis is, how he works, his service, reviews and how to book a call.
- [Experiences](/get-inspired): Twenty themes that shape a day in Amsterdam, each with its own page.
- [For travel advisors](/travel-agents): How Dennis supports agents, concierges and their clients in Amsterdam.
- [Notebook](/notebook): Short stories and observations from Amsterdam.
